dirichlet_bc_xmin.description: Dirichlet ghost-cell prescription at xmin for cell-centered uniform Cartesian grids (ESS §9.2 / §9.4). The ghost cell u[-1] is set so that the linear interpolation to the xmin boundary face gives the prescribed value: u_ghost = 2*u_bc - u[0]. Pattern matches the synthetic `bc` node (§9.2); `kind` and `side` fields are spec-compliant annotations — ESS pattern matching on these fields is pending. `produces` declares the ghost variable per §9.4 (not yet processed by the current rule engine; documented for forward compatibility). Analytic check: (u_ghost + u[0]) / 2 = (2*u_bc - u[0] + u[0]) / 2 = u_bc.
